europe_now.title: Major Ukrainian Drone Attack Targets Moscow Region
europe_now.summary: Ukraine launched a massive drone attack on Moscow, killing two people and hitting a fuel hub. This was described as one of the biggest aerial assaults on the Russian capital during the conflict.

sources.headline: Ukrainian drones kill two, hit fuel hub in one of biggest attacks on Moscow region
Ukraine fires nearly 900 drones at Russia, says Moscow

europe_now.title: Former German Spy Chief Arrested on Espionage and Treason Charges
europe_now.summary: A former German intelligence official was arrested over allegations of espionage and treason involving leaked BND files. The investigation highlights significant security concerns within the country's intelligence community.

sources.headline: German ex-spy chief arrested over espionage and treason allegations involving leaked BND files

top_stories.title: Escalating Student Protests and Social Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of students have demonstrated across France to demand better education and protest police handling of clashes. The government is facing pressure to address the grievances as the demonstrations continue to grow.

sources.headline: 'Tense' atmosphere as tens of thousands join French student protests
Tens of thousands demand better education in demonstrations across France

top_stories.title: EU Budget Strategy and Funding Concerns Ahead of Summit
top_stories.summary: The European Commission president has defended the EU's multi-trillion euro spending plan ahead of an upcoming summit. At the same time, lawmakers have warned against quickly restarting funds for Hungary due to corruption concerns.

sources.headline: Von der Leyen joins MEPs in defence of EU’s €2 trillion spending plan ahead of summit
MEPs warn against EU rush to restarting funds for Hungary while corruption and plurality concerns remain

top_stories.title: Escalating Aerial Attacks and Regional Security Impacts
top_stories.summary: Ukraine fired nearly 900 drones at Russia in a major attack that caused casualties and infrastructure damage. The escalation has heightened security concerns across Central and Eastern Europe.
